layouts.name: Cover
layouts.use_when: The first slide of every deck: the question, restated as the answer.

layouts.name: Headline + Trend
layouts.use_when: One measure over time, 1-3 series. The default for a trend answer.

layouts.name: KPI + Trend
layouts.use_when: A single headline number is the answer and a trend explains how it got there. Put the number in `kpi` (short, e.g. '$1.25m') and what it measures in `kpi_label`.

layouts.name: Ranked Bars
layouts.use_when: A ranking or comparison across groups — who is highest, lowest, fastest.

layouts.name: Table
layouts.use_when: The rows themselves are the answer — a breakdown a reader will scan or copy. Keep to about 10 rows.

layouts.name: Sources & SQL
layouts.use_when: Appended automatically by the builder as the last slide — never choose it yourself.
